problem: Let $c=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ and $d=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ -3\end{aligned}].$ Find the vector projection of $c$ onto $d.$
worked_solution:
Using the formula for the vector projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{d}\,c & =\frac{c\cdot d}{d\cdot d}d \\  & =\frac{{c}_{x}{d}_{x}+{c}_{y}{d}_{y}+{c}_{z}{d}_{z}}{{d}_{x}^{2}+{d}_{y}^{2}+{d}_{z}^{2}}d \\  & =\frac{1\cdot 1+2\cdot 3+1\cdot (-3)}{{1}^{2}+{3}^{2}+(-3)^{2}}d \\  & =\frac{4}{19}⟨1,3,-3⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{4}{19},\frac{12}{19},-\frac{12}{19}⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
